pieces.Text: By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality to better suit you. Even wish, however, has its limits. A wish spell can produce any one of the following effects - Duplicate any technomancer spell of 6th level or lower; Duplicate any other spell of 5th level or lower; Undo the harmful effects of certain spells, such as feeblemind; Produce any effect whose power level is in line with the above effects. At the GM's discretion, you may try to use a wish to produce greater effects than these, but doing so may be dangerous or the spell may have only a partial effect. A duplicated spell allows saving throws and spell resistance as normal, but the save DCs are the same as for a 7th-level spell. For the purpose of other effects that depend on spell level, wish counts as a 9th-level spell.
